about: The example projects the Qt program's start page lists (docs/upgrade/qt_gui.md section 19.9; user guide getting_started/examples.rst). One entry per reaction; variants of the same reaction under it. Paths are relative to the folder that holds examples/. Each entry is checked by tests/gui/gui_casual_test.cpp (it exists, opens with no dialog and no warning note, and validates).
